electric-violet.$description: Electric Violet — Primary CTA buttons, active nav items, accent keywords in headlines, focus rings — the only chromatic element allowed to break the monochrome canvas, making every action feel switched on

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Secondary accent for interactive highlights, selected states in tool surfaces, and inline brand emphasis where a cooler note is needed

deep-indigo.$description: Deep Indigo — Primary text and headings — a near-black with a violet undertone that warms the monochrome palette and distinguishes the brand from flat-charcoal SaaS defaults

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Heaviest text weight, section titles, and surface-dark contexts — a deeper step than Deep Indigo for maximum contrast moments

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary body text, descriptions, metadata — sits between Deep Indigo and Silver for layered reading hierarchy

silver.$description: Silver — Muted helper text, placeholder copy, disabled labels, and icon secondary tones

fog.$description: Fog — Icon strokes at rest, subtle surface borders, low-emphasis dividers

mist.$description: Mist — Primary hairline borders across cards, inputs, dividers, and component edges — the dominant structural neutral

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, elevated panels, button text on violet fills, inverted icon strokes

bone.$description: Bone — Alternate surface for nested panels, input fills, quiet sections within white pages

pebble.$description: Pebble — Page canvas, section bands between white blocks, product mockup backgrounds, footer wash

sunset-gradient.$description: Sunset Gradient — Decorative gradient endpoint for marketing visuals and showcase cards

bloom-gradient.$description: Bloom Gradient — Decorative gradient endpoint for showcase cards and hero illustration accents

plus-jakarta-sans.$description: Sole typeface across the product. Geometric humanist sans with subtly squared terminals — contemporary but not cold. Weight 700 carries display and headings for confident vertical presence; weight 500 serves UI controls and labels; weight 400 handles body and descriptions. The slight openness in counters at small sizes keeps labels legible on dense tool surfaces.

google-sans-code.$description: Google Sans Code — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
